description.zh: 两个词只差一个音、意思就不同（如 pat 和 bat），这组词叫最小对立，那个能区分意义的音就是一个音位；音位之间往往只差一个发音特征，比如声带振不振动（清 / 浊）。
description.en: When two words differ in a single sound and mean different things (pat and bat), they form a minimal pair, and the meaning-changing sound is a phoneme; phonemes often differ by just one articulatory feature, such as whether the vocal folds vibrate (voiceless vs voiced).

aliases.zh: 复数 s 为什么有时读 z
aliases.en: why is plural s sometimes pronounced z

label.en: Voicing is the vocal folds vibrating

reason.zh: 声音来自振动；清和浊的区别不是音量，而是发音时声带振不振动——摸着喉咙念 /s/ 和 /z/ 就能感觉到。
reason.en: Sound comes from vibration; voiceless versus voiced is not about loudness but whether the vocal folds vibrate — touch your throat while saying /s/ and /z/ and you can feel it.

label.zh: 辅音靠发音特征，元音靠共振峰
label.en: Consonants by features, vowels by formants

reason.zh: 辅音的对立多由发音部位、方式和清浊这些开关决定；元音的区别则落在声道共鸣上，用前两个共振峰 F1、F2 在平面上定位。
reason.en: Consonant contrasts are mostly set by switches — place, manner and voicing; vowels differ in the vocal tract’s resonances and are located on a plane by the first two formants, F1 and F2.
